# f5os_ldap_server (Resource)

Manages an individual LDAP server within an LDAP-type server group on F5OS. LDAP servers must be defined within a named server group before they can be referenced by authentication policies.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "f5os_ldap_server" "example" {
  server_group = "ldap-servers"
  address      = "192.0.2.10"
  auth_port    = 636
  type         = "ldaps"
}

# Example with default LDAP port (389)
resource "f5os_ldap_server" "example_standard" {
  server_group = "ldap-servers"
  address      = "192.0.2.11"
  # auth_port defaults to 389 for 'ldap' type
  type = "ldap"
}

# Example with minimal configuration (uses device defaults for port and type)
resource "f5os_ldap_server" "example_minimal" {
  server_group = "ldap-servers"
  address      = "192.0.2.12"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) IP address or hostname of the LDAP server.
- `server_group` (String) Name of the LDAP-type server group containing this server.

### Optional

- `auth_port` (Number) LDAP server port (default: 389 for ldap, 636 for ldaps).
- `type` (String) Connection type: 'ldap' or 'ldaps'.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server group and address identifier (computed)
